templates.why_chosen: A star exemplar: the Graph Optimizer panel stacks three small labelled graphs, each with visible branching nodes, to show three different query-specific dataflow-graph optimizations produced from the same declarative input.
templates.what_to_learn: Stack two or three small example graphs inside the box that produces them to show a family of possible transformations, using small filled and outlined circles for operators; label each of the three so a reader can tell which optimization pass produced which graph, since this exemplar leaves that unlabelled.
